summary: Iteration 80 - DocumentScanner with Web Worker + OffscreenCanvas architecture. ALL 12 TESTS PASS. The scanner uses a stateful Web Worker at /workers/scanner.worker.js for non-blocking image processing. File upload, filters (B&W, Contraste+, Original), rotation (left/right), multi-page support, and save functionality all work correctly.

TEST_1_SCANNER_OPENS.details: Scanner modal opens from DocumentUploader scanner-open-btn (visible on mobile). Shows document-scanner test-id.

TEST_2_GUIDE_PHASE.details: Guide phase renders with: scanner-title ('CamScanner'), scanner-start-btn ('Ouvrir la camera'), scanner-file-btn ('Choisir une photo'), scanner-close, scanner-ready-badge ('Traitement OffscreenCanvas — UI fluide garantie'), and 4 scanner-tip elements.

TEST_3_FILE_UPLOAD.details: File upload via scanner-file-input triggers Web Worker processing. Console shows '[ScannerWorker] OffscreenCanvas worker ready'. Preview image appears after processing.

TEST_4_FILTER_BW.details: Noir & Blanc filter (filter-bw) highlights with bg-emerald-500 when selected. Worker applies binarize() filter.

TEST_5_FILTER_ENHANCED.details: Contraste+ filter (filter-enhanced) highlights when selected. Worker applies adjustContrast() filter.

TEST_6_FILTER_ORIGINAL.details: Original filter (filter-original) highlights when selected. Worker restores original image data.

TEST_7_ROTATE_LEFT.details: Rotate left button (rotate-left-btn) triggers Worker rotation. Image rotates -90 degrees.

TEST_8_ROTATE_RIGHT.details: Rotate right button (rotate-right-btn) triggers Worker rotation. Image rotates +90 degrees.

TEST_9_ACTION_BUTTONS.details: All action buttons present: preview-confirm-btn ('Valider / Sauvegarder'), preview-retake-btn ('Reprendre'), preview-add-page-btn ('Page suivante').

TEST_10_CLOSE_BUTTON.details: Close button (scanner-close) closes the scanner modal. document-scanner element removed from DOM.

TEST_11_WORKER_LOADS.details: Web Worker loads from /workers/scanner.worker.js. Console shows '[ScannerWorker] OffscreenCanvas worker ready'.

TEST_12_NO_SCANNER_ERRORS.details: No console errors related to ScannerWorker or OffscreenCanvas. (Note: OCR module has separate errors unrelated to scanner)

TEST_MULTI_PAGE_FLOW.details: Tested separately - upload first image -> click 'Page suivante' -> camera phase -> upload second image -> 'Terminer (2 pages)' button appears. Page counter shows '1' after first page added.

TEST_SAVE_FUNCTIONALITY.details: Clicking 'Valider / Sauvegarder' triggers Worker.save() -> finalizing phase -> scanner closes (file passed to parent DocumentUploader via onCapture callback).

web_worker_architecture_validated.react_hook: useScannerWorker() returns { previewUrl, capture, applyFilter, rotate, save, reset, error, isProcessing }
web_worker_architecture_validated.offscreen_canvas: Used for all image processing - main thread never blocked

notes: HTML hydration warnings (span in select/option) are from DossierExpressPage form selects, not related to scanner
Camera access fails in headless browser (expected) - file upload path tested instead
OCR module has separate 'postMessage Worker' errors related to Tesseract.js - not related to scanner
Scanner button (scanner-open-btn) only visible on mobile viewport due to 'flex sm:hidden' class

critical_code_review_comments: Web Worker architecture correctly implemented - all image processing in worker, main thread only receives preview blobs
useScannerWorker hook properly manages Worker lifecycle with useEffect cleanup
Memory leak prevention: URL.revokeObjectURL called on previous preview URLs
Worker uses OffscreenCanvas for createImageBitmap, getImageData, putImageData - true non-blocking processing
Error handling in place: worker.onerror, message type 'error', save timeout (10s)
Filter functions (binarize, adjustContrast) work correctly on ImageData
Rotation updates originalImageData after transform - allows re-applying filters to rotated image

success_rate.frontend: 100% - 12/12 scanner tests passed + multi-page and save tests verified

test_credentials.client: N/A - scanner accessed from public /dossier-express form
